title: IASO CAR-T therapy
summary: A Chinese-developed CAR-T therapy approved for multiple myeloma.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

IASO Biotherapeutics gained approval in China in 2023 for equecabtagene autoleucel, a BCMA-directed CAR-T therapy for relapsed multiple myeloma. It is one of several Chinese cell therapies competing on cost and speed of development, with domestic manufacturing and pricing well below US list prices. Access is limited by hospital capacity and reimbursement.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Early commercial
Estimated window 2023–2028
Confidence label Confident
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

Chinese cell therapy is becoming a source of licensed assets for global pharma, not only a domestic market.

What Would Change The View

  • Reimbursement and hospital adoption.
  • Long-term durability data.
  • Out-licensing deals to global partners.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
